text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock a lightweight prio-ops playbook for sequencing customer-driven asks vs platform bets. TL;DR: still using RICE but want firm guardrails for deps + staffing so teams don't get overloaded.

sam: agree. can we make a 2-tier flow? urgent customer blocker vs roadmap candidate. keep the roadmap candidates in weekly intake.

jordan: +1. also propose a hard cap: max 3 concurrent customer-engine tasks per eng subteam, unless triaged to oncall/bug SLA.

tia: can we codify the RICE calc in the playbook and include a check for cross-team deps? suggestion: any item with \"external dependency\" flagged forces a dependency ticket with owner before work starts.

maya: exactly — and add an \"ops budget\" effort multiplier for things requiring platform changes. makes effort bigger so score drops unless impact is huge.

ashok: sharing a quick example we used last quarter for a FinCorp ask:
```
# RICE example
Reach = 0.05  # 5% of weekly requests
Impact = 3    # 1-5 scale
Confidence = 0.7
Effort = 4    # dev-weeks
Score = (0.05 * 3 * 0.7) / 4 = 0.02625
```
ashok: low score -> deprioritize unless legal/compliance forces it.

sam: procedural proposal:
- Intake form -> product triage (weekly) -> RICE + dep flag -> tier assignment (urgent / fastpath / backlog)
- If dep_flag=true -> dependency ticket + owner assigned within 3 business days or blocked.
- If urgent -> fastpath meeting, 2-day SLA on staffing decision.

maya: agree. we also need launch criteria for customer-driven fastpaths: 1) API contract stable, 2) integration tests green in staging, 3) fallback route (simpler model) configured, 4) rollback plan documented.

jordan: on staffing: propose a small pool of \"cross-team float\" engineers (0.5 FTE per squad equivalent) who are assigned to the intake queue to unblock in first 2 sprints. documented in PLAYBOOK.

tia: how do we keep this from being abused? product can't shift it to \"urgent\" to bypass roadmap.

maya: gate: CSM or legal must +1 urgent for customer-driven. product can't self-flag urgent without evidence. ops-bot will auto-label urgent claims without evidence as \"needs justification\".

ops-bot: Reminder: please fill intake form at https://intranet/redwood/intake within 48 hours of customer ask. Missing intake -> deprioritized.

ashok: can we add a simple sequencing heuristic: prefer work that (a) reduces unit cost, (b) unlocks multiple customers, or (c) fixes reliability with low dev effort. rank tie-breaker by ops-bot telemetry (cost delta estimate).

sam: sounds good. we should capture this in a 1-pager and run a 30-min sync with eng leads + product next Tues.

maya: I'll draft the 1-pager. want it to include: intake flow diagram, RICE formula + example, dep rules, staffing float rules, launch criteria.

tia: assign owners for each section before the sync? i can take launch criteria and rollback playbook.

jordan: i'll own staffing float + queue cap enforcement. ashok -> RICE examples + ops multiplier. sam -> intake flow + tooling.

maya: perfect. last note: add a clause that any item causing >5% P95 latency regression requires QA signoff and can be escalated to SRE.

ops-bot: Meeting created: \"Prio Ops Playbook sync\" Tue 10:00. Attendees: product leads, eng leads, sres. Calendar invite sent. :calendar: 

maya: thanks all — please add any edge cases to the doc i'll share in #product-docs. :thumbsup:
